title: Register in Leiden and get your BSN

shortSummary.text: Choose the correct registration route, prepare your papers and arrange your municipal appointment.

whoThisIsFor.text: International students moving from abroad to live in Leiden.

whenYouNeedIt.text: Start before arrival, once you know where you will live.

prerequisites.text: Start before arrival, once you know where you will live.

requiredDocuments.text: Valid ID and housing evidence; applicable civil-status records for first registration. Check Leiden’s exact list, including cohabitation consent where relevant.

estimatedTime.note: Leiden states at least five working days for processing, depending on the case. Appointment waiting time is separate.

estimatedCost.note: Municipal registration is free. Document preparation may have separate costs.

numberedSteps.title: Choose BRP or RNI
numberedSteps.body: Staying longer than four months? Use resident registration. For a shorter stay, check RvIG’s RNI route and eligible desks.

numberedSteps.title: Check your documents
numberedSteps.body: Read Leiden’s document list. For foreign civil-status records, check the issuing-country instructions before arranging legalisation or translation.

numberedSteps.title: Arrange the appointment
numberedSteps.body: Complete Leiden’s form; use the emailed link to book. Attend in person with the required papers.

numberedSteps.title: Check the result
numberedSteps.body: Ask how you will receive confirmation. An existing BSN remains valid; registration is not an application for a second number.

warnings.text: RNI is not a substitute for resident registration during a long stay.

commonMistakes.text: Do not assume that every foreign document needs the same legalisation.

tips.text: After registration, check the DigiD application requirements.

Ask how you will receive confirmation. An existing BSN remains valid; registration is not an application for a second number.

faqs.question: Already have a BSN?
faqs.answer: Keep using it; returning residents do not receive a new number.

faqs.question: Missing a document?
faqs.answer: Ask Leiden which papers are required for your appointment; do not guess whether a substitute is accepted.

faqs.question: Staying briefly?
faqs.answer: Check the RNI desk rules at RvIG. Eligibility of desks differs by passport.

emergencyInformation.text: This guide cannot decide your personal case. Use the responsible institution for help.

sections.title: Check before acting
sections.body: Official wording differs: NetherlandsWorldwide says register within five days; Leiden says arrange an appointment within five working days. Book before arrival and ask Leiden immediately if the timing is unclear.

nextActions.text: After registration, check the DigiD application requirements.
